claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Olopatadine is a zwitterionic, highly polar antihistamine that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would be weak and non-selective, likely reflecting cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress or general off-target activity rather than H1 antagonism.
